reports.title: Futu Announces Third Quarter 2026 Unaudited Financial Results

desk.headline: Revenue up 4.5% to HK$6.7bn, in line with the estimate; profit flat as trading slowed; no guidance given
results: Revenue rose 4.5% to HK$6.7bn but fell 7.1% from the June quarter; net income was flat at HK$3.19bn.
Brokerage commissions fell 4.1% to HK$2.8bn as the average commission rate dropped to 5.6bps from 7.5bps, despite 28% higher trading volume.
Interest income rose 3.8% to HK$3.2bn; other income jumped 65.5% on currency exchange and fund distribution fees.
Funded accounts reached 4.0m after 163,000 net additions; net asset inflows were about HK$34.5bn.
Wealth management client assets rose 11.8% to HK$196.4bn; margin lending fell 22.3% from the June quarter to HK$73.8bn.

guidance.summary: Futu gives no financial guidance. Management said it remains confident in long-term growth despite weaker markets.

points: Softer markets, especially a sharp drop in chip and AI shares, cut client trading in the quarter.
Mainland China's share of revenue fell from about 20% in Q1 to the low teens in Q3 and is expected to fall further over the next two to three quarters.
Moomoo Japan reopened normal account opening on 24 Sep but is holding back on big marketing while compliance fixes continue.
Clients moved into money market funds; Hong Kong high-net-worth clients now exceed 10,000.
Management expects the US retail business to move past break-even in 2027.
